system: Islamic (sharia) legal system with English common law influences, primarily in commercial matters

constitution.amend: proposed by Parliament; passage requires at least three-quarters majority vote by its membership and the signature of the president of the republic; passage of amendments to constitutional articles on rights and freedoms and the terms of office of Parliament and of the president also requires a majority vote in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of the chief justice and 6 justices)
courts.judges: Supreme Court judges appointed by the president in consultation with the Judicial Service Commission -- a 10-member body of selected senior government officials and the public -- and on confirmation by voting members of the People's Majlis; judges serve until mandatory retirement at age 70
courts.lower: High Court; Criminal, Civil, Family, Juvenile, and Drug Courts; Magistrate Courts (on each of the inhabited islands)

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Maldives

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
